claude.sample_unit: subjects (255 non-AD, 281 MCI, 711 AD) from UK memory clinics
models_evaluated: Volumetric MRI ML 'CN vs. AD' model
Volumetric MRI ML 'CN vs. MCI vs. AD' model

links.outcome: Performance drop of CN vs AD model on external real-world clinical dataset
links.effect: Volume-normalized 'CN vs. AD' model BAC fell from 87.7% internally to 81.5% in SLaM-BRC due to misclassification of non-AD subjects with hippocampal atrophy.
links.quote: The volume-normalized 'CN vs. AD' model (87.7% balanced accuracy [BAC]) led to decreased performance in the SLaM-BRC (81.5% BAC) due to misclassifications of non-AD subjects with evidence of hippocampal atrophy.

links.outcome: Model performance across magnetic field strengths (1.5T vs 3.0T) and external site
links.effect: 87.1% of 93 subjects had the same class assignment at 1.5T vs 3.0T; CN vs MCI vs AD model BAC stayed similar (55.3% vs 54.6%).
links.quote: Our 'CN vs. AD' model showed similar performance when tested at different magnetic fields (1.5T vs. 3.0T: 87.1% of 93 subjects had the same class assignment).
